logic.entry: At each completed UTC daily close t, require close[t] strictly greater than max(high[t-E:t]); the E prior daily bars exclude the compared signal-day bar. Also require CMF_N[t] strictly greater than 0.05. If both pass and the sleeve is flat, desire long.
logic.exit: At each completed UTC daily close t, exit an existing long when close[t] is strictly less than min(low[t-30:t]); the 30 prior bars exclude the compared signal-day bar. CMF is entry confirmation only; it never independently exits.
logic.cmf: For each completed bar j, multiplier=(2*close[j]-high[j]-low[j])/(high[j]-low[j]); use 0 when high==low. money_flow_volume=multiplier*quote_volume[j]. CMF_N[t]=sum(money_flow_volume[t-N+1:t+1])/sum(quote_volume[t-N+1:t+1]); return 0 if denominator is 0. The signal bar is included because its full OHLCV is available at its close. Raw range is [-1,+1]; no *100 scaling.
logic.execution: Signal availability is daily bar open time + 86400000ms. Execute any state change only at the next UTC day 00:01 1-minute bar open, after the daily close is available. OOS begins with cash at 2025-09-19 00:01 UTC and ends by terminal liquidation at 2026-09-14 00:01 UTC. Never fill at the signal close or past historical price after a delayed decision.
logic.allocation: One 2,000 USDT portfolio with independent BTC and ETH long-only sleeves, raw initial weights 0.50/0.50 (1,000 USDT each). No leverage, shorting, interest, cross-sleeve transfers or rebalancing. A sleeve holds only its own coin plus residual USDT.
logic.close_channel: Entry and exit extrema are computed solely from completed bars before t; the signal-day close/high/low are never included in the channel being compared.
